messages.subject: problem with long lines of code when hosted at own server
parts:
Hi,

I have an app that works fine on my machine but throws an 'unexpected end of input' error when hosted on the server. The error points to long lines of code and when I remove those lines (which are just helpText in my case), everything works fine again. Splitting one helpText into two or more does not help because fewer and fewer symbols are tolerated in every following line of code.

I would greatly appreciate a hint how to deal with that.

Thanks in advance!

Bogdan
